title: Airport Lounge Access With Your Elevate Pay Visa Signature Virtual Card
summary: Use your Elevate Pay Visa Signature virtual card with Visa Airport Companion to find participating lounges, check visit prices and access your membership.
body_markdown:
Your Elevate Pay Visa Signature virtual card works with Visa Airport Companion, where you can find participating airport lounges and check paid entry options.


Register your card in the app to see your available benefits. Lounge visits are pay as you go, so check the price and entry conditions before you visit.


## What is Visa Airport Companion?


Visa Airport Companion is Visa's app for airport benefits, run with its lounge partner DragonPass. You sign up with your Visa Signature card, and the app becomes your membership.


From there, you can search an airport, see which lounges are open to you, and show a QR code at the door. At some airports, the app also lists dining, retail and other services for Visa cardholders.


## What this means for you


Use the app to find a participating lounge where you can wait, work or charge your phone before boarding.


Lounge visits are paid. Check current visit prices, guest charges and entry conditions in the app before you travel. Entry also depends on lounge capacity.


## What you need first


-


An issued Elevate Pay Card.


-


Your card details. In the Elevate Pay app, open your card from the bottom menu and tap it to see the details.


-


A smartphone with the Visa Airport Companion app. Lounge entry is through the app, so you will need your phone at the airport.


## How to sign up


1.


Download **Visa Airport Companion** by Dragon Pass Company Limited from the App Store or Google Play.


2.


Open the app and start sign-up.


3.


On the **Card details** screen, enter:


-


**Name on Visa card:** your name as it appears on your Elevate Pay Card.


-


**Visa card number** , **Expiry date** and **CVV:** from the Elevate Pay app.


-


**Country/region of card issuance:** select **Puerto Rico** .


4.


Follow the remaining on-screen steps to set up your account.


Once you're signed up, you land on the home screen with your membership benefits and nearby airport services.


## How to find lounges and other services


1.


Tap **Explore** in the bottom menu.


2.


Search for your airport and choose a terminal, or keep **All terminals** .


3.


Switch between **Lounge** , **Dining** and **Retail** to see what's available.


4.


Tap a lounge to see where it is, which terminal it's in, and whether it's **Walk-in or Prebook** .


Available lounges and services differ by airport and terminal. Check the app before you travel.


## How to get into a lounge


1.


Tap **Membership** in the bottom menu.


2.


Your active Visa Signature membership shows here, with your membership QR code and cardholder name.


3.


At the lounge, show the QR code to the lounge staff.


The Membership screen also shows Pay as you go details. Tap How it works to see how access is charged before you arrive.


**Tip:** make sure the name on your membership matches your travel ID, since lounge staff may check it.


## Frequently asked questions


### Can I get into a lounge with just my card?


No. Lounge entry is through your membership QR code in the Visa Airport Companion app. Sign up before you get to the airport.


### Is lounge access free?


No. Lounge visits are pay as you go. Open Membership and tap How it works to check current charges before you visit.


### Is entry guaranteed?


No. Entry depends on lounge capacity on the day you travel. If a lounge is full, use Explore to look for another one nearby.


## Ready for your next trip


Register before you travel so you can check your membership, visit prices and lounge options in advance.


Learn how to[top up your card](https://help.elevatepay.co/hc/en-us/articles/53078664510225-How-do-I-top-up-my-card) ,[pay with it](https://help.elevatepay.co/hc/en-us/articles/53078767873041-How-do-I-pay-with-my-card) , or[lock it in the app](https://help.elevatepay.co/hc/en-us/articles/53079000796305-How-do-I-lock-or-unlock-my-card) .
